prompt: Create ONE standalone botanical illustration for The Vegetable Guru inner pages, not a page layout. References 2 and 3 are APPROVED BOOK HERO ART and must govern drawing style: bold simplified silhouettes, broad crisp colour and shadow planes, dimensional hand-shaped vector-like botanical drawing, rich natural crop colours, lime and forest greens, tapered cream highlight slashes and occasional rhythmic scalloped highlights, a few major veins only. No fine ink hatching, no watercolour, no pencil, no grain or mottled texture, no photographic skin gloss, no black outline. Ignore and DO NOT reproduce the reference heroes' green/black background haze. Genuinely transparent PNG background, no glow, no halo, no cast shadow or ground plane, no white backing, no lettering or border. Keep the entire silhouette inside the canvas with 7% clear padding. Large high resolution. Landscape 3:2. Isolate the casually heaped fresh pea pods at the front of the photograph, retaining the photographed varied directions, curves and overlaps. Select about twelve pods to form a loose shallow pile with some full silhouettes visible. Remove the container and background vines; no invented flowers or loose shelled peas. Avoid a tidy fan, row or symmetrical display. Keep bright fresh green pods and a few blunt pedicels, graphic highlights and readable large forms.
